defects: Produced conclusion uses `Module.rank` (cardinal-valued rank) while gold uses `finrank` (the ℕ-valued, Cardinal.toNat-truncated rank) — these are different Mathlib notions expressing a different, non-equivalent proposition (finrank equality can hold trivially whenever both sides are infinite-dimensional, even if the underlying cardinal ranks differ, so it does not imply, nor is it equivalent to, cardinal rank equality)

Produced statement omits the localization data present in gold's hypothesis context: the submonoid p : Submonoid R, the module M, the localized-module map f : M →ₗ[R] N with [IsLocalizedModule p f], and hp : p ≤ R⁰ — dropping structure the gold theorem is parameterized over
